_meta.purpose: Wording for the client-facing result screen. Draft in Banfield's voice (Brand Standards: warm, conversational, confident without exaggeration; warmth leads, proof follows). Never mention client types, scores or fit here; tests enforce this.
_meta.placeholders: {firstName} is replaced with the client's first name.
_meta.projectLines: Each line reflects one of the client's own answers back to them: 'question' is a question id from questions.json and 'prefix' goes before their answer.
_meta.cta: bookingUrl is a placeholder until the real booking page exists. Name and email are added to it so the booking form can be pre-filled. Says 'us' rather than naming Jamie until Banfield decides (see DISCOVERY open questions).

intro: No right or wrong answers here. Just a few things that help us understand you, your home and how you like to work.
closing: We'd love to work with you.
